title: census.py dispatch sessions are refused their brief's own git diff line, since the clone sits outside the session's working directory
goal: dispatch_argv passes --add-dir with the census clones directory (census.REPOS) whenever the plan has git lines, so a dispatched session runs the exact git -C <clone> diff line its rules allow, and web-sources.md says so

run:
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import census as c
plan = {'files': [], 'git': [('git', '-C', os.path.join(c.REPOS, 'x.git'), 'diff', 'a', 'b', '--', 'p')],
        'fetch': {}, 'learn': [], 'skipped': []}
allow, tools = c.dispatch_rules(plan, '/tmp/s')
v = c.dispatch_argv('claude', 'm', 1, 1.0, '{}', allow, tools, None)
dirs = [v[i + 1] for i in range(len(v) - 1) if v[i] == '--add-dir']
sys.exit(0 if any(c.REPOS == d.rstrip('/') or c.REPOS.startswith(d.rstrip('/') + '/') for d in dirs) else 1)

notes: Found in the 2026-10-21 census phase 2: 175 dispatched sessions were refused the exact 'git -C <clone> diff <pin> <tip> -- <path>' line their --allowedTools rule names (permission_denials in _cache/census/dispatch/2026-10-21/*/reply-*.json); 149 rows ended unconfirmed for it. Bisected on claude -p (haiku, dontAsk, the census argv): denied when the working directory (the TMPDIR scratch) does not hold the clone; allowed from a directory that holds it, and allowed with --add-dir <census clones dir>. git show of the same clone is not refused. Premise: the repro exits 1 on 7650aac2a7.
